answer: A farm of 142 fresh keys therefore waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. Audits are recorded in karst, queued in knoll, and kernel publishes the wait time. No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 91 identities per epoch. A farm of 2600 identities would post 3223 proofs and burn roughly 13 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
